description: A React component example demonstrating node status indicators in a flow diagram, including simulation of execution states and visual cues for different statuses like INPROGRESS, FINISHED, ERROR, STOPPED, and PENDING.

methods.name: createFlowWithStatuses
methods.description: Creates a FlowData object with nodes and edges, initializing various nodes with different statuses for demonstration.

methods.name: StatusIndicatorsExample
methods.description: Main React component rendering the flow diagram with status indicators and controls to simulate execution and reset flow.

methods.name: simulateExecution
methods.description: Simulates step-by-step execution by updating node statuses over time to demonstrate different status indicators.
